name: browser-cdp
title_zh: 用 Chrome 原生调试协议直接操控浏览器
tagline_zh: 不装插件、不碰 Selenium，一条 CDP 通道就能截图、执行 JS、抓页面。适合爬虫和自动化测试。
tagline_en: No plugins, no Selenium—just raw CDP for screenshots, JS eval, and scraping. Chrome-family only.
desc_en: Native CDP browser automation reference. Headless/headed Chrome control, screenshots, JS evaluation. (/browser-cdp, browser automation, cdp, scraping)
why_zh: 直连 Chrome 的调试端口，比 WebDriver 少一层翻译，响应快、控制细。
why_en: Talks straight to Chrome's DevTools port—skips WebDriver's translation layer for faster, finer control. Full native protocol.
limit_zh: 只支持 Chrome/Edge 等 Chromium 内核浏览器；需要预先以 --remote-debugging-p。
limit_en: Chromium-only; requires launching with --remote-debugging-port; headed mode fails without a display server.
